meta.name: shared-loading-dots
meta.description: 当 cook-web 需要新增共享 loading 动画时，使用本技能统一公共组件目录、非破坏性导出方式，以及圆点序列动画的可配置实现。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统一共享 loading 动画的组件目录与导出方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中统一管理公共动画组件
copy.tagline_en: Standardize shared loading animation component directory and exports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to unify shared animation components across your project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在 cook-web 项目中新增或修改共享圆点 loading 组件，确保动画可配置（数量、大小、间距、时长），颜色跟随主题变量，并通过命名导出避免影响现有默认 Loading。
howto.when: 当你在 cook-web 项目中需要新增共享 loading 动画时触发，尤其是圆点序列动画。

say.text: 在聊天页的流式输出下方添加一个轻量圆点 loading。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will add or modify a shared dot-loading component in the cook-web project, making the animation configurable (count, size, gap, duration), colors following theme variables, and using named exports to avoid affecting the existing default Loading.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add a shared loading animation in the cook-web project, especially a dot-sequence animation.

say_en.text: Add a lightweight dot loading below the streaming output on the chat page.
say_en.note: Claude will use smaller size/spacing and reuse muted-foreground color.

say_en.text: Create a configurable dot loading for a button scenario with count=3, size=8, gap=4, durationMs=600.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the component with those props and use bg-primary color.
